senses.gloss: m. (v. בָּאלָא; = תור ברא, v. תּוֹר III) aurochs.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Deuteronomy 14:5">Targ. O. Deut. XIV, 5</cite> (ed. Berl. <cite ref="V00314"><he>תּוּ׳</he></cite>; ed. Vien. <cite ref="V00282"><he>תּוֹר־בָּלָא</he></cite>; h. text <he>תאו</he>; Y. <he>תורי בר</he>).—

Ḥull. 80ᵃ (ref. to תאו, Deut. l. c.) מדמתרגמינן ת׳ וכ׳ (Rashi תּוֹרְבָּאלָא) since we translate it torbala (ox of the desert; Rashi: ‘ox of the Lebanon’?), it proves that it belongs to the class of cattle.
